# ALDATA — Aluminum & Interior Decorators

> ALDATA is an interior design, aluminium, steel, kitchen, and renovation
> company based in Sadiqabad and Dahrki, Pakistan. "We Don't Just Design,
> We Create Experiences."

## Key pages

- [Home](/): overview, featured projects and services
- [Projects](/projects): full project portfolio, filterable by category
- [Services](/services): interior design, aluminium/steel work, kitchens,
  renovation, and related services
- [Videos](/videos): behind-the-scenes and project walkthrough videos
- [FAQ](/faq): common questions about services, locations, and quotations
- [Contact](/contact): phone, email, WhatsApp, and both office locations

## Notes for agents

- Content on this site (projects, services, videos, FAQs) is managed
  through an admin panel and may change at any time; treat listings as
  current at time of crawl, not static.
- The `/admin` and `/api` paths are private and disallowed — see `/robots.txt`.
